name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45 degree angle from your body.
Lower until your chest is close to the floor, or as far as is comfortable.
Press the floor away to return to the starting position.
technique_considerations: Keep your hips in line with your shoulders and heels rather than sagging or piking.
If this is too hard, place your hands on a sturdy raised surface or lower your knees to the floor.
Keep your neck relaxed and your gaze slightly ahead of your hands.
